If the patient survives, which of the following would ultimately be the most common cell type at the injured region of the frontal lobe?

The reasoning chains consistently support that astrocytes outnumber other cell types after injury, aligning with the consensus that astrocytes play a crucial role in repair and recovery following brain injury. Therefore, the most common cell type at the injured region of the frontal lobe, if the patient survives, would be astrocytes.
